automations.name: Important Email Intake
natural_phrases: tell me if an email needs action
automations.pigeon_action: Summarize the newest actionable content, extract deadlines, and suppress noise.
automations.alert_when: The email contains a direct ask, deadline, logistics change, billing/account issue, school/family item, or failure notification.
automations.quiet_when: The email is marketing, a generic newsletter, a receipt with no action, or a duplicate thread update.
automations.deepagents_role: Launch background investigation only when the email requires research or multi-source investigation.

automations.name: Webhook Incident Triage
natural_phrases: tell me if this service alert matters
automations.pigeon_action: Classify severity, summarize the symptom, and decide whether to launch a deeper investigation.
automations.alert_when: Severity is high, repeated failures cross threshold, or the payload names a service the user cares about.
automations.quiet_when: Severity is low and no threshold is crossed.
automations.deepagents_role: Use background investigation for log/doc/config investigation after the event is classified.

automations.name: Commute Delay Watch
natural_phrases: tell me if my commute is bad
keep an eye on my route
automations.pigeon_action: Check travel time against baseline and suggest an alternate route when useful.
automations.alert_when: Primary route exceeds baseline by the configured threshold.
automations.quiet_when: Delay is below threshold or duplicate within dedupe window.
automations.deepagents_role: None by default; DeepAgents can review patterns weekly.

automations.name: Close Game Watch
natural_phrases: tell me if the game is close late
keep an eye on close games
automations.pigeon_action: Sleep between games and alert when a followed team has a close game late.
automations.alert_when: Score margin and clock match the configured close-game threshold.
automations.quiet_when: No active game or game is not close.

automations.name: Weekly Automation Review
automations.trigger: manual Telegram request or weekly schedule
automations.pigeon_action: Ask DeepAgents to inspect workspace skills, recent logs, and existing automations, then produce an improvement brief.
automations.alert_when: The review finds broken automations, noisy alerts, missing dedupe, or high-value improvements.
automations.quiet_when: No meaningful changes or failures are found.

automations.name: Deep Research Queue
automations.trigger: Telegram phrase: dig into this / research this / investigate this
automations.pigeon_action: Run a DeepAgents research job, persist report/sources/transcript, and return a compact summary.
automations.alert_when: The job completes, fails, or needs user clarification.
automations.quiet_when: Only when the user explicitly asks for quiet/no-notification mode.
approval_needed_for: side effects beyond reading, searching, and reporting
